g.text: Chart Of Account Reference : Chart Of Accounts
Ledger Accounting Method or Basis : LedgerAccountingBasisTypeValues
Ledger Posting Rule and Permission : Condition
Ledger Legal Entity or Business Unit Reference : Organisation[1..*]
Financial Accounting Transaction Reference : Financial Accounting Transaction
Financial Accounting Transaction Posting Date : DateTime
Financial Accounting Transaction Amount and Currency : Amount
Booking Schema Posting Rule : Rule Set
Financial Accounting Transaction (Accounting Event): A recorded entry in the accounting
system (ledger) that represents the financial impact of a real-world transaction.
Created in the General Ledger (GL) or sub-ledger. Typically via a booking schema.
- Accrual of interest income: Debit “Interest Receivable” / Credit “Interest Income”
Booking Schema = Rulebook for posting transactions
Accounts = Target of debits and credits
Journal / Journal Entry = Container of the postings
*** All accounting concepts_Ledger, Account, Journal, Journal Entry, Journal Entry Line, Booking
Schema, and Chart of Accounts_ are alignment with GAAP.
Financial Transaction (Business Event): A real-world economic event that has financial
implications for a customer or the bank.
Occurs outside or within the bank’s operational systems. Examples: Loan disbursement to
a customer, deposit into a savings account, withdrawal at an ATM, interest accrual, fee
